help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How the panel works, every command and who can do what.
help.panelHint: Everything you can do from here.

player.title: Now playing
player.body: Cover, title, artists, who asked for it and the genres when they are known. Below: the position slider, previous, play or pause, next, loop (off, queue, track), shuffle and volume. Stop clears the queue after a confirmation.

queue.title: Queue
queue.body: Paste a link or search to add songs. Drag the handle to reorder, use the cross to remove a song and Clear to empty the queue. History lists the last songs played and lets you add one again.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.body: Lyrics come from LRCLIB. Synced lyrics highlight the current line and follow the song; tap a line to jump to it. Some songs only have plain lyrics, and some have none.

radio.title: Radio
radio.body: Starts an endless mix from your history, your likes and similar listeners. You can add a short prompt such as "calm music to study". While it picks songs, the queue shows each step and you can cancel it. At the bottom, Your taste shows your top genres: click one to see its songs and remove the ones you do not want on your radio.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Only for server managers: control mode, the DJ list, vote to skip, the queue limit and the default volume.

privacy.title: Account
privacy.body: The round button with your picture, top right: theme and accent color, language, your listening history and deleting your data. Your taste is at the bottom of the Radio tab.

language.title: Language
language.body: Change it in your account (top right). It changes the panel language for you only. The bot's messages in the channel keep the server's language.

jam.title: Jam
jam.body: Invite to jam (in the panel or on the Now playing message) shares a link. Whoever opens it gets the panel in their own voice channel and can join: every channel plays the same queue at the same position, and the volume stays per channel. The host channel decides who may join (other channels of the server, other servers), who edits the shared queue, closes the jam, removes channels or ends it. Joining saves your channel's own queue; it comes back when you leave or the jam ends. If the host channel empties, the host role passes to the channel that joined first. Jams are not kept across a Lynx restart: each channel resumes its own queue.

help.seekNote: Moving to a point in the song is only possible here, with the slider. There is no seek command.
help.feedbackNote: Like and Dislike tune your radio: a dislike keeps that song out of your mixes.
help.commandsHint: Type them in any text channel of the server while you are in a voice channel.

play.description: Joins your voice channel and plays a link (YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify track, album or playlist) or the best match for a search.

skip.description: Skips to the next song. When vote to skip is on, your use counts as a vote.

stop.description: Stops the music, clears the queue and leaves the channel.

nowplaying.description: Shows the current song with its position.

remove.description: Removes a song by its position in the queue. Without control you can only remove your own.

move.description: Moves a song to another position in the queue.

skipto.description: Jumps straight to a song in the queue, dropping the ones before it.

loop.description: Sets the loop mode: off, track or queue.

volume.description: Sets the volume from 10 to 100. 100 plays the audio untouched.

lyrics.description: Shows the lyrics of the current song.

ai.description: Starts the AI radio, with an optional prompt. Use it again or /stop to end it.

help.accessNote: Control means the command follows the server's control mode. Vote means it can need votes from the channel.
help.permissionsHint: Checked by the bot on every action, in the panel and in commands.

manager.title: Lynx manager
manager.body: The server owner and anyone with Administrator or Manage Server. Managers can always control playback and are the only ones who see Settings.

dj.title: DJ
dj.body: People a manager added to the DJ list in Settings. It is a Lynx list, not a Discord role. DJs control playback in any mode and skip without votes.

modes.title: Control modes
modes.everyone: Everyone (default): anyone in the voice channel can pause, skip, seek, reorder and remove songs.
modes.dj: DJs only: only DJs and managers control playback. Everyone else can add songs and remove their own.

vote.title: Vote to skip
vote.body: Off by default. When a manager turns it on, a skip needs a set number or share of votes from the people listening. DJs and managers skip right away.

support.title: Thanks for using Lynx!
support.body: Lynx is free and open source. If it makes your listening sessions a little better, consider dropping a star on GitHub: it really helps the project grow. Ideas, bug reports and pull requests are always welcome too.

stored.title: What is stored
items: The last 2000 different songs you requested: title, artist, link, how many times you played each one and when you last played it.

used.title: What it is used for
items: Your AI radio and your genre taste.
Finding listeners with a similar taste across servers, anonymously.
It is never shown to other users.

off.title: When it is off
items: Like, Dislike and /ai are turned off for you.
You are left out of other people's recommendations.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting is immediate and cannot be undone. This removes:
items: Your listening history (every song, play count and date).
Your taste profile (genres and radio data).
Your similarity links with other listeners, in both directions.
itemsNoAi: Anything Lynx stored about your listening.
danger.kept: Your panel settings (language, theme, accent and the history switch) are kept.
